description:
Produce a bounded integration design only for a private BitSlice experiment that qualifies through existing abstractions.

## Background

The plan fixes BitSlice as a bit view and authorizes no new public borrowed-word API. A qualifying existing-abstraction result may be designed through current private storage and kernel boundaries. A result requiring public API or shared infrastructure closes as a no-change design record with a pending owner decision for a later explicitly authorized container; this issue never waits for that authority.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The design maps qualifying evidence to one bounded private consumer integration through existing canonical abstractions, or emits a closed no-adoption record without proposing code.
- [hard] REQ-02: Alignment, bit offset, logical length, tail masking, safety, scalar fallback, and complexity contracts are explicit for any implementable private route.
- [hard] REQ-03: Any public borrowed-word API or shared-infrastructure requirement terminates this story branch as no-adoption plus a pending owner decision, with no implementable contract for that route.

## Notes

This is a design-only issue; it makes no production change and cannot block on ungranted authority.
title: Design the qualifying zero-copy integration
